newsitem.title: INDIA: Reliance, HLL boost Delhi shares.
newsitem.headline: Reliance, HLL boost Delhi shares.

text.p: Steady buying in Reliance Industries and Hindustan Lever Ltd drove shares on the Delhi bourse to a higher close on Friday, brokers said.
The Delhi Stock Exchange sensitive index ended 8.05 points higher at 776.55
Reliance closed 3.10 rupees higher at 299 on buying triggered by rumours that the firm was planning to make a bonus issue.
Hindustan Lever surged 17 rupees to 1,100 on steady buying by speculators.
Trading on the Delhi bourse was extended by 90 minutes. The stock exchange closed at 5:15 p.m. (1145 GMT).

"The recovery in stock prices will definitely bring back confidence among investors who have been on the sidelines for a long time and are likely to resume buying," said Ashok Kaul of brokers Rajpaul Chadha and Co.

Hero Honda Motors rose 14.90 rupees to 502.90 on foreign investors' buying. The company on Tuesday announced a net profit of 503.6 million rupees for 1996/97 (April-March) compared with 263.4 million rupees in the previous year.
Larsen and Toubro gained 4.15 rupees at 210.95. On Thursday the company had announced a rise in net profit to 4.1 billion rupees in 1996/97 (April-March) from 3.9 billion in the previous year.
State Bank of India closed 1.05 rupees up at 307.05 on buying by financial institutions.
